optical.principle: optical alignment takes precedence over mathematical centering
optical.volume: icons should occupy comparable perceived visual weight, not identical geometric bounds
optical.negativeSpace: critical counters and gaps must remain legible at the target size

rules: Remove secondary detail before changing the primary contour.
Merge geometry only when the merge improves recognition at the target size.
Preserve directional terminals and interaction cues.
Protect critical counters and negative-space gaps from collapsing.
Do not independently redraw a Micro icon without a canonical 24px source.
A Micro variant may simplify geometry but must retain the canonical icon name and semantic metadata.
